verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents Wrangler as its official command line tool. Its docs state that the core Wrangler commands cover creating, developing, and deploying Workers, and that rollbacks can be done with Wrangler instead of the dashboard, so the whole deploy lifecycle runs from the terminal. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the deploy command and its CLI authentication flow, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI-only deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote: The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
A command line tool for building [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/).
You can roll back to a previously deployed version of your Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard.
